description: This file defines an Angular component named 'MultipleChoice' which renders a stylized select dropdown with options, handles changes, and interacts with its processor and data context.

classes.name: MultipleChoice
classes.description: An Angular component for rendering a multiple-choice dropdown, extending DynamicComponent, with inputs for options, value, and description, and handling user selection changes.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events on the select element, updating data via the processor if the selection is valid.

ctags.name: options
ctags.pattern: /^  readonly options = input.required<{ label: Primitives.StringValue; value: string }[]>();$/

fields.name: readonly options = input.required<{ label: Primitives.StringValue; value: string }[]>();
